page: Microsoft Azure EC64ads_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage capabilities include 2458 GB of local SSD storage, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

The high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU positions this instance as a resource-dense option for memory-intensive workloads. The inclusion of 2458 GB of local SSD storage provides high-capacity local scratch space, though users requiring public IPv4 connectivity should note that complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included. The hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and data analytics tasks that require substantial RAM and fast local storage.
